captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of two separate, symmetric solid blocks with curved outer profiles and flat inner faces. Each block resembles a segment of a rounded rectangle or capsule that has been cut in half, leaving a wide gap between them. Their vertical walls are straight, and the top and bottom surfaces are completely flat.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable luggage tag with rounded corners and an attachment slot. The design should automatically calculate the plate size based on the input text length and lines, and support either engraved or embossed text.
captions.factory: The design uses a 'plate' module containing a 2D square with a minkowski-applied circle, extruded using linear_extrude. A 'slit' module is created similarly with a square and circle minkowski combination to form a capsule-shaped hole. A boolean difference operator subtracts the slit and optionally the text (using the write library) from the main plate, while positive text depths are added as an embossed union.
